description: What the top 5 games of a ranked niche lack: complaint themes with their sample sizes, player requests (theme "Requests for new features" when detected), structure (multiplayer or not, max players per server, update cadence, paid passes, big studio or brand) and retention, plus factual observations and an honest list of missing data (dataGaps). Use it to pick an angle for an original game; null and measured=false mean no data, not zero. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

niche.description: Ranked niche label or key (from list_niches or find_opportunities), e.g. "Tycoon".

platform.description: roblox or fortnite (ranked niches exist on these two). Omit for both.

measured.description: false = no theme published for this scope: no data, not zero complaints.
